name: GetMailFolders
description: Retrieves mail folders from a specified mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox to retrieve folders from.

fields.name: IncludeHiddenFolders
fields.label: Include Hidden Folders
fields.description: Whether to include hidden folders in the results. Hidden folders are typically system folders that are not visible in the standard folder list.

fields.name: Top
fields.label: Top
fields.description: Number of folders to retrieve for pagination.

fields.name: Skip
fields.label: Skip
fields.description: Number of folders to skip for pagination.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the list of mail folders.
